t.fMusS: Complete recited Mushafs; each reciter’s Mushaf is in its own section in the podcast app.

t.copiedHint: Link copied. Paste it in your app.
t.alexaMore: It starts where the website radio is playing. To control it: “Alexa, next” for the next surah, and “Alexa, stop” to stop.
t.alexaBtn: Enable the skill in the Alexa store
t.altLiveD: Works on all devices, including older ones
t.vlcPc: M3U or live link in VLC: copy the link → open VLC → Media → Open Network Stream (Ctrl+N) → paste → Play. Turn on Loop for playlists.
t.vlcIos: M3U or live link in VLC: copy the link → open VLC → Network → Network Stream → paste → Open Network Stream.
t.vlcAnd: M3U or live link in VLC: copy the link → open VLC → More → New stream → paste → Play. The live link also works in any radio app that accepts a station URL.
t.rssPc: RSS in Pocket Casts (pocketcasts.com or the app): Search → paste the link in the search box → Subscribe.
t.rssMac: RSS in Apple Podcasts (Mac): File → Follow a Show by URL → paste the link.
t.rssAp: RSS in Apple Podcasts: Library → ⋯ or Edit → Follow a Show by URL → paste the link.
t.rssOv: RSS in Overcast: + → Add URL → paste the link.
t.rssAnd: RSS in Podcast Addict / AntennaPod: + → Add by RSS URL → paste the link.
t.rssPcA: RSS in Pocket Casts: Search → paste the link in the search box → Subscribe.
t.dlAllHint: The collection is too large for a single ZIP, so add this list of links to a download manager to get everything at once:
t.dlPc: Computer: JDownloader or Internet Download Manager → Add links → paste or import the file.
t.dlAnd: Android: ADM app → import the link list from the file.
t.waqf: This radio is a waqf for the sake of Allah. Help spread it: whoever guides to good is like the one who does it.
t.mailL: For feedback and suggestions, and if you hold rights to any material we will remove it as soon as you ask:
t.loadErr: Could not load this recitation, moving to the next…
t.shareMsg: Listen to "Recitations of the Holy Quran", live Quran radio around the clock
t.instBarS: Open the radio in one tap, like an app
t.instBarL: Add Tartil to your home screen
t.instT: Add Tartil to your Home Screen
t.instIos1: Tap the Share button {share} in the browser bar
t.instIosN: In Safari the Share button is in the bottom bar
t.instPcS: In Chrome and Edge the install window appears directly. Other browsers:
t.instPc2: Firefox: drag the lock icon from the address bar onto your desktop
t.offPlay: No internet connection. Saved recitations play from My downloads.
